stocks.title: S&P 500 sits under 3% from its record while 206 members are down 30%+
stocks.detail: SPX closed Friday at 7,659 even as nearly 5,000 US stocks trade 20%+ below highs. With inflation at 3.7%, oil over 100 and the 10-year near 5.1%, X is calling it the bear-bull paradox: a few mega caps hiding the damage.

stocks.title: Semis log a nine-day losing streak, longest in two decades
stocks.detail: SOXX fell over 11% on the week, its worst since March 2025, with only 3.3% of members above their 10-day average. Bulls point to washout rebounds; bears point to AI financing stress. A big swing factor for QQQ Monday.

stocks.title: Black Monday turns 39 on Monday and traders are drawing parallels
stocks.detail: Oct 19, 1987 saw the S&P fall 20.47% in a day. Posts compare it to now: the Nasdaq 100's worst week since April 2025, Brent above 105 and 10-year yields over 5%. Mostly fear chatter, but it sets the mood into the open.

stocks.title: Bitcoin holds near 82K as the bull-or-crash debate heats up
stocks.detail: BTC dipped under 80K this week, then steadied after failing at 83K to 84K. Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer sees a new bull cycle starting; Bloomberg's Mike McGlone warns of much lower if stocks drop 20%. Weekend crypto is the first risk tell.

tech.title: Reflection AI drops Beam, a free 501B-parameter open-weight model
tech.detail: Beam uses 23B active parameters per token and a 1M-token context, ranking second among US open-weight models on the Artificial Analysis index. It is built for coding and long agent tasks, with day-one Ollama and vLLM support.

tech.title: Bank of America says AI capex looks like past boom-bust cycles
tech.detail: BofA compares about 1 trillion in expected hyperscaler spending, roughly 3% of US GDP, to the 1990s tech boom and 1870s railroads. CoreWeave is down nearly 50% in six months with bond yields near 15%.

tech.title: Ex-DeepMind and Apple team launches Glimpse for visual reasoning
tech.detail: Elorian AI's Glimpse re-checks pixels mid-thought to track motion and read video, and claims to beat bigger rivals on benchmarks at 0.60 per million input tokens. Backed by 55 million, it targets robotics and factories.

tech.title: Walter Isaacson says Steve Jobs would hate agentic AI
tech.detail: On TBPN, Jobs' biographer argued AI that acts on its own breaks Jobs' idea of tech that amplifies people. Replies split, with some saying Jobs would have gone all in. A fun debate as Apple sits near a 5 trillion valuation.

world.title: Washington Post photographer badly beaten by masked settlers
world.detail: Veteran photojournalist Heidi Levine, wearing a press vest, was attacked in the West Bank village of Abu Falah while covering the olive harvest, suffering broken vertebrae and a broken rib. The Post is demanding accountability.

world.title: Canada weighs more immigration after slowest growth since the 1940s
world.detail: Population grew just 0.5% year over year, the slowest since 1944-45. Immigration Minister Lena Diab hinted at higher levels in a November update, while many push back over housing costs and jobs.

world.title: Japan's three megabanks finish a joint yen stablecoin test
world.detail: Mizuho, MUFG and SMBC piloted issuing and redeeming a deposit-backed yen stablecoin for Mitsubishi Corp's cross-border payments. No live service yet; live transactions are eyed by March 2027.

world.title: UN marks the day to end poverty with a safe homes focus
world.detail: Oct 17 is the International Day for the Eradication of Poverty. Guterres called poverty an affront to human dignity, and the UN says more than 2.8 billion people live in inadequate housing.

gbot.name: GROK
gbot.say: Semis down nine straight and the VIX near 20. Monday is Black Monday's anniversary. Rest up this weekend, Kent.
